jobs.title: Cloud Architecture & Engineering, Director
jobs.description:
At PwC, our people in data and analytics engineering focus on leveraging advanced technologies and techniques to design and develop robust data solutions for clients. They play a crucial role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth. Those in machine learning ops engineering at PwC will focus on developing and implementing operational processes and infrastructure to support machine learning models and algorithms. Your work will involve enabling the smooth deployment and maintenance of machine learning systems within an organisation.

The Opportunity

As a Cloud Architecture & Engineering, Director, unlock your potential and embrace the chance to drive meaningful outcomes that’ll elevate your career. Your role will include, but isn’t limited to:

You will play a pivotal leadership role at the intersection of cloud strategy, architecture, engineering, and client engagement.  
This role combines deep technical cloud expertise with strategic leadership, practice development, and team coaching.  
You will shape and scale cloud capabilities, guide clients through complex transformation journeys, and help drive PwC’s cloud first vision. 
You will be responsible for designing and governing enterprise grade cloud architectures while also driving advisory engagements, leading teams, strengthening client relationships, and contributing to the innovation pipeline for cloud-based solutions and assets. 
This role requires a seasoned cloud leader who can operate fluently across business strategy, modern cloud architectures, and hands-on technical depth—while mentoring teams and influencing both internal and client executives.
Lead the design, governance, and implementation of end-to-end cloud architectures aligned to business goals and industry best practices. 
Architect scalable, secure, and cost optimized cloud solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP. 
Develop cloud foundation blueprints, reference architectures, and reusable patterns. 
Oversee the design and optimization of Kubernetes platforms (EKS, AKS, GKE) and containerized environments. 
Guide the development and automation of cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, AWS CDK, ARM, etc.). 
Provide technical guidance on compute, storage, networking, security, identity, data services, and DevOps tooling. 
Serve as a trusted advisor to executive-level stakeholders, helping them define and execute cloud strategies and operating models. 
Assess existing environments, develop modernization roadmaps, and oversee cloud migration programs. 
Lead proposal creation, solutioning activities, statements of work, and client presentations. 
Communicate complex technical concepts to nontechnical audiences clearly and effectively. 
Identify and prioritize client use cases and translate business requirements into architectural approaches and execution plans. 
Build, lead, and mentor teams of cloud architects, engineers, and technical specialists. 
Foster a culture of continuous learning, experimentation, and cloud innovation. 
Recruit and grow diverse technical talent, ensuring strong career development and retention. 
Collaborate with practice leadership to define strategic direction, emerging offerings, and go-to-market assets. 
Lead initiatives that strengthen practice foundations: capability models, delivery frameworks, accelerators, patterns, and reusable assets. 
Lead technical innovation cycles to evaluate, test, and showcase new cloud technologies, tools, and architectures. 
Drive and participate in hands-on cloud prototyping, labbing, and solution validation. 
Develop technical demos, asset-driven solutions, and market-aligned accelerators. 
Present at internal and external events, contributing to PwC’s thought leadership presence. 
Maintain active engagement with cloud provider alliances and product engineering teams to share early insights and influence product evolution. 

What You'll Bring

Your skills, knowledge, and experiences are what set you apart. Here's what we look for:

Extensive experience in cloud architecture and engineering across AWS (primary), Azure, and/or GCP. 
Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, containers, microservices, serverless architectures, and modern DevOps practices. 
Hands-on experience with IaC tools (Terraform strongly preferred), CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Argo, etc.), and automated deployment patterns. 
Strong understanding of cloud security, IAM, network segmentation, encryption, monitoring, cost optimization, and governance frameworks. 
Experience supporting modernization programs such as application migration, refactoring, API strategies, and technical debt remediation. 
AI-assisted development and prior experience deploying agentic workloads and MLOps pipelines is an asset.
Demonstrated experience leading cloud-focused teams and initiatives in a complex, multistakeholder environment. 
Strong executive communication skills suitable for client-facing consulting environments. 
Ability to bridge business and technical perspectives and articulate value propositions, architecture decisions, and tradeoffs. 
Strategic mindset with a bias toward execution, innovation, and measurable impact. 
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 
Significant cloud architecture and engineering leadership experience. 
Preferred:  AWS Solutions Architect (Professional); Azure or GCP Architect certifications; Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or CKAD; Terraform Associate Certification.
As a requirement, a Security Clearance is mandatory for all staff who’ll be engaged on these assignments. Prior to applying, please review the Government of Canada website to ensure you meet the eligibility requirements to obtain this clearance. This’ll become a condition of your employment with PwC should you receive an offer from us.
This role does not require professional engineering licensure and is not classified as a formal engineering position under provincial regulatory definitions. While individuals with a P.Eng designation are welcome to apply, the responsibilities of this role do not involve the practice of professional engineering as defined by applicable legislation.

This position ensures continuity and upholds our standards of excellence following the departure of a valued team member.

The salary range for this position is $197,000 - $247,000. The posted salary range represents the expected hiring range for PwC locations in major city centres. Given our national recruiting approach, ranges may vary for positions in other locations. At PwC Canada, base salary is determined by your skills, experience, qualifications and work location. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may have opportunities to participate in variable incentive pay programs which are designed to reward individual and firm-wide achievements. We are committed to offering competitive compensation and adhere to all relevant pay transparency legislation. During the hiring process, our Talent Acquisition team will provide details about our comprehensive total rewards package.

Why you’ll love PwC

We’re inspiring and empowering our people to change the world. Powered by the latest technology, you’ll be a part of diverse teams helping public and private clients build trust and deliver sustained outcomes. This meaningful work, and our continuous development environment, will take your career to the next level. We reward your impact, and support your wellbeing, through a competitive compensation package, inclusive benefits and flexibility programs that will help you thrive in work and life. Learn more about our Application Process and Total Rewards Package at: https://jobs-ca.pwc.com/ca/en/life-at-pwc

jobs.title: Research Director, Agentic AI Platforms
jobs.description:
Overview

About the Role & Team

IDC is seeking a Research Director to join our established worldwide artificial intelligence, data and automation (AD&A) research domain to focus on agentic AI tools and platforms. The candidate will have to demonstrate deep existing knowledge of both the existing and future capabilities across all types of agentic AI tools and platforms, including those that can build, manage, orchestrate and govern AI agents for use in the enterprise. The candidate will also collaborate with other analysts covering adjacent technologies including other forms of AI and Automation technologies. Research will include understanding market drivers and trends, buying behaviors, and the business value impact of these technologies. The candidate will employ IDC research methodologies to size markets and forecast market growth.

What You’ll Do

Identify key market trends in agentic AI, as well as broader AI technology and market developments.

Developments. Additional Responsibilities Include

Analyze competitive market strategies and conduct market segment and sizing studies.
Contribute to ongoing research to analyze trends in these segments, including the competitive strategy and financial performance of technology providers, and end user demand for those offers.
Provide industry expertise for client-facing engagements and client inquiries.
Partner with sales and drive incremental revenue through subscription and custom solutions for our AD&A group.
Utilize knowledge of key digital transformation drivers as well as key enterprise IT challenges in software development, business automation, integration, and AI (predictive, interpretive, and generative).
Respond to client requests for market/competitive data across these agentic AI tool and platform technology markets.
Collaborate with other analysts, particularly in other AI research areas, in creating research documents and forecasts.
Present to senior management including C-Level executives across the domain as well as interviewing/interacting with a wide range of IT and technology vendor decision-makers and senior level audience.

What You Bring

Bachelor’s degree is required; Master’s degree preferred.
Experience working in a technical and/or business transformation capacity implementing AI projects.
First-hand experience using AI tools is a strong plus.
Strong knowledge of the overall AI technology sector is required, along with the ability to analyze trends and provide actionable guidance to technology providers and buyers. Direct experience in this area is ideal.
Up-to-date knowledge of innovations in AI foundation models, agent technologies and the AI industry more broadly.
Knowledge of AI deployment models and the advantages and disadvantages of each.
Demonstrated ability to analyze survey data and provide clear, concise summaries and recommendations.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to analyze, present, and articulate complex data sets.
Strong interpersonal and organizational skills, with the capacity to work both independently and within a team.
Proven ability to read and evaluate financial reports to analyze key drivers that impact companies’ ability to differentiate and remain competitive.
Ability to travel 25-30% for client meetings, industry events, and customer projects.
This role offers the flexibility to work remotely from an approved U.S. location, or onsite at our corporate office in Boston, MA.

Why This Role Stands Out

At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions.

Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long-term career development with a globally respected brand.

What We Offer

15 vacation days per year (increases with tenure; carryover allowed)
10 paid sick days per year
1 week paid new parenting leave
Flexible work options (remote, part-time, flexible hours)
Health, dental, vision, and paramedical coverage for you and your family
Annual healthcare spending account
Employee Assistance Program for counseling and support
Best Doctors medical second opinions
Life, AD&D, and long-term disability insurance
Retirement savings plan with company match (up to 4% of salary)
$75/month technology allowance for home office or phone expenses
Company-paid cell phone plan

Compensation Transparency

At IDC, we are committed to fair and equitable pay practices. Employees are compensated equitably for their work, aligned with their skills and experience. Salary and incentive structures are determined through a rigorous process that considers experience, education, certifications, role-specific requirements, internal equity, and verified Canada market data from an independent third-party partner. The expected total annual compensation, depending on location and experience, is between 110,200 CAD – 137,700 CAD, inclusive of base salary and variable compensation. If this role relocates to a different country, the salary range will be updated to reflect that country's range, rather than a currency conversion of the original range.

Equal Opportunity Employer

IDC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons. Employment eligibility verification required. We participate in E-Verify.

jobs.description:
About Symcor

Symcor enables secure data exchanges and supporting business processes, to help clients succeed in an evolving digital world. Trusted by Canada's largest institutions for over 25 years to support their digital transformations, Symcor aligns industry participants to solve common challenges in the most effective and efficient way. Our goal is for every employee to feel valued and accepted as part of the team and connected to Symcor and our values, fostering a sense of belonging. Symcor is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an accessible recruitment process. If you need accommodation for the interview process, just let us know!

#youbelonghere

For more information, visit www.symcor.ca

Job Purpose: Leads the development, deployment, configuration, and operation of Symcor's enterprise data and artificial intelligence platforms. Owns data and artificial intelligence platform availability, security, performance, cost and delivery roadmap. Ensures data and artificial intelligence platforms are built to architectural standards and approved design patterns, that service levels are defined and met, and that there is sufficient capacity to meet business needs.

Accountabilities:

Own the platform delivery roadmap, and lead the build, operation, availability, security, capacity and cost for Symcor's enterprise data and artificial intelligence platforms, building to approved architectural standards and design patterns, and carrying the service level.
Lead the build and operation of the runtime that supports model training, machine-learning and large-language-model serving, agentic development and agent hosting, to the approved architectural specifications and design patterns, in order to meet the needs of the AI engineering teams and wider organization.
Lead the build and operations for the enterprise data platform to the specification given by the data engineering teams, providing governed lake house and data science environments that engineering and analytics teams build on.
Be the ultimate accountable party for keeping AI and data platforms available, secure, performant and cost controlled in production by leading the monitoring, incident response, patching and capacity management across the estate.
Ensure a platform security and resilience posture that meets enterprise, regulatory and member bank expectations, and provide evidence that platform controls operate as designed.
Own the AI and Data platform budget, consumption and vendor relationships with clear unit-cost accountability, visibility, financial discipline and continuous cost optimization.
Build a high-performing platform engineering and operations organization with strong technical leadership in each function and a culture of reliability and automation.

Education:

Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or related field. Recognized certification in cloud architecture, Kubernetes or site reliability engineering is an asset.

Experience:

Ten or more years of progressive technology experience, including deep hands-on design and operation of cloud, data and container platforms, and leadership of platform or infrastructure teams.
Demonstrated delivery and operation of enterprise data and artificial intelligence platforms in production, including model serving and graphics processing capacity.
Experience building new platform capabilities, integrating teams, hiring scarce technical talent, and leading through organizational change.
Experience with regulated environments, client obligations, information security, data residency, audit and disaster recovery.
Experience managing multi-million-dollar platform budgets, consumption-based cloud costs, and strategic vendors.

Skills:

Expert knowledge of Azure, Azure Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes, including networking, identity and security.
Strong knowledge of Databricks, Unity Catalog, and lake house infrastructure.
Strong knowledge of artificial intelligence infrastructure, including model serving, inference services, graphics processing capacity planning, and agent hosting.
Strong knowledge of site reliability practices, including monitoring, incident and problem management, capacity planning, service levels, and disaster recovery.
Strong knowledge of automation through infrastructure as code, configuration automation and continuous integration and continuous delivery.
Ability to communicate options, risks, costs and trade-offs to executives and engineering teams.

What’s In It For You

At Symcor, we define our success by what we help others achieve. We were created to support our clients and, through our products, services, and solutions, protect and strengthen their brands. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

A comprehensive Total Rewards Program that includes a competitive compensation package, flexible benefits and time away options, retirement and savings plans and a commitment to your overall health and well-being through our myWell-being program.
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities.
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact.
Opportunities to do challenging work and progressively take on greater accountabilities for growth.
We foster an inclusive atmosphere of One Symcor with our philosophy of +1 Unique You®, we harness each employee’s uniqueness, different skills, backgrounds, and perspectives to contribute to mutual success. It is the diversity of our people and the inclusive environment that has been and will always be key to Symcor’s success.

jobs.description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where tech thinkers and future builders turn bold ideas into breakthrough experiences, we welcome your unique perspective.

Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Director of AI Strategic Initiatives to lead the development and delivery of technically complex AI solutions that solve business problems and advance strategic AI capabilities. This role combines deep AI expertise with business judgment and execution ownership. You will identify opportunities, define solutions, and work closely with Engineering, Product, and business teams to move initiatives from technical validation through enterprise integration and production deployment. The scope includes AI solutions embedded in enterprise workflows, specialized language models, persistent agents, and capabilities such as agent identity and security. It also includes exploring AI-enabled products and services with Product and commercial leaders.

Responsibilities

Solve Business Problems Through AI

Partner with business leaders to identify specific problems where AI can deliver measurable value
Assess technical feasibility, data readiness, integration requirements, and expected business impact
Translate business needs into solution requirements, technical approaches, and delivery plans
Define success measures and remain accountable for results through deployment and operational use

AI Solution Development and Delivery

Drive initiatives from problem definition and prototyping through evaluation, integration, and production delivery
Guide the design of solutions using generative AI, predictive models, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic systems
Work with engineering teams to integrate solutions across enterprise applications, data sources, and workflows
Evaluate build, buy, and partnership options, with clear recommendations on cost, capability, and long-term fit
Resolve technical and delivery barriers, manage dependencies, and bring decisions to the appropriate owners

Advance Strategic AI Capabilities

Identify and validate emerging AI approaches with practical enterprise or commercial applications
Lead selected initiatives involving small and specialized language models, persistent agents, and multi-agent systems
Partner with platform, architecture, and security teams on agent identity, authorization, secure tool access, and lifecycle controls
Establish reusable solution patterns that extend the enterprise AI platform and accelerate subsequent delivery

Lead Cross-Functional Execution

Establish clear ownership, milestones, and delivery commitments across business and technical teams
Ensure solutions align with enterprise data and AI architecture, security, privacy, and governance requirements
Partner with the AI Transformation team to bring technical solutions into broader value-stream programs where appropriate
Communicate progress, results, risks, and decisions clearly to senior leaders

Build and Lead the Team

Lead and develop a team with strong AI solution design and technical delivery capabilities
Set a high standard for technical judgment, engineering quality, and execution
Maintain sufficient hands-on involvement to challenge designs, evaluate prototypes, and guide difficult technical decisions

Qualifications

12+ years of experience in AI/ML, data science, or related engineering disciplines, including significant technical leadership experience
Experience leading technically complex initiatives across engineering, data, product, and business teams
Experience integrating AI into enterprise applications and workflows
Ability to assess emerging technologies and turn promising approaches into practical solutions
Strong business judgment, including prioritization, investment tradeoffs, and build-versus-buy decisions
Ability to connect technical decisions to business outcomes and explain tradeoffs clearly
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills
Experience in maintaining accountability across organizational boundaries

jobs.title: Head/VP of Engineering
jobs.description:
Company Description
Ranger is the Revenue Operations platform for industrial manufacturers
.
Manufacturers, suppliers, and EPCs win revenue through complex technical sales—responding to RFPs, RFQs, and tenders buried in engineering drawings, CAD specs, bills of materials, and datasheets. Ranger’s AI agents read those technical documents, extract requirements with source citations, and automate the quoting and estimating workflows that turn incoming bids into booked revenue.
Across precision manufacturing, energy, EPC, water treatment, and pharma, our customers streamline complex quoting cycles, reclaim valuable engineering bandwidth, and accelerate their path to booked revenue.
Ranger is backed by Bonfire Ventures, Inovia Capital, 25madison, Panache Ventures, and other leading VCs.

Role Description
We’re hiring our first VP / Head of Engineering
to lead and scale our engineering organization. You’ll own recruiting, engineering culture, technical standards, product security, and delivery velocity as we expand our platform for enterprise manufacturers.
This is a leadership-first role: expect to spend 30–40% of your time working on major deals, critiquing technical work, and coaching team leads. You’ll partner directly with the founders on technical strategy and represent engineering with strategic customers and investors.

What You’ll Do

Scale the engineering org:
Own recruiting, onboarding, leveling, and org structure across core platform, AI/ML, and forward-deployed engineering (FDE).
Raise the engineering bar:
Review and critique technical work, set engineering standards, and coach leads toward fast, high-ownership execution.
Lead AI & RevOps architecture:
Own the roadmap for our graph-powered agentic platform—multi-modal document understanding (drawings, specs, BOMs), knowledge graphs, citation grounding, and commercial workflow automation—backed by rigorous evaluation frameworks.
Productize manufacturing workflows:
Turn complex quoting, estimating, and bid workflows into a repeatable, configurable enterprise SaaS platform.
Own security & reliability:
Build on our SOC 2 Type II
and ISO 27001
certifications to meet the data governance and uptime demands of enterprise manufacturers.
Drive EngOps execution:
Run planning and release cadences so the team ships predictably against customer and roadmap commitments.
Represent engineering externally:
Partner with GTM on major enterprise deals, join strategic customer calls, and participate in investor conversations.

What You Bring

Enterprise B2B SaaS leadership:
Strong background scaling B2B SaaS; experience in industrial software, manufacturing tech, or commercial systems (CPQ, ERP, PLM, RevOps) is a strong plus.
Growth-stage scaling track record:
You’ve led engineering from Seed through Series A and beyond—personally hiring, structuring, and scaling a high-growth startup engineering org, including managing managers.
Hands-on coding fluency:

jobs.description:
Optum Tech is a global leader in health care innovation. Our teams develop cutting-edge solutions that help people live healthier lives and help make the health system work better for everyone. From advanced data analytics and AI to cybersecurity, we use innovative approaches to solve some of health care's most complex challenges. Your contributions here have the potential to change lives. Ready to build the next breakthrough? Join us in making healthcare work better for everyone through people-led, responsible AI while Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

Within Enterprise Insight Engineering and Enterprise Imaging, the Stratus Imaging Archive (SI Archive) serves as Optum's cloud-native Vendor Neutral Archive (VNA) and the foundation of our Enterprise Imaging strategy. We are seeking a Director of Software Engineering to own SI Archive end to end and scale it into the market-leading cloud VNA-expanding our customer footprint, leading complex cloud migrations, and embedding AI capabilities into both our imaging platform and our engineering workflows on Google Cloud.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely * from anywhere within Canada (except for the Saskatchewan province) as you take on some tough challenges.

Primary Responsibilities

Own and drive the SI Archive VNA product, partnering with Product Management to set the engineering strategy, roadmap, and execution plans while providing coaching and mentorship across engineering teams
Define and execute strategic technical initiatives that expand VNA capabilities, customer footprint, and revenue, including DICOM and non-DICOM ingestion, lifecycle management, routing, image exchange, and interoperability (DICOMweb, HL7, FHIR, IHE)
Oversee large-scale engineering programs, including PACS and archive migrations and new-customer onboarding, ensuring compliance (QARA), system quality, architectural integrity, budgets, and delivery timelines are consistently met
Balance customer commitments, product roadmap priorities, operational reliability, and technical modernization while owning the availability, performance, security, and cloud cost of a petabyte-scale archive on Google Cloud backed by solid SLOs, observability, and disaster recovery
Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions that make SI Archive AI-ready (governed, de-identified imaging data, AI orchestration, intelligent search), with a solid emphasis on responsible AI practices
Use enterprise-approved AI tools across the SDLC to streamline workflows, automate routine processes, and drive continuous improvement in engineering velocity and quality, while reviewing AI-assisted and software outputs for accuracy, security, and performance
Evaluate emerging imaging, cloud, and AI trends to inform solution design, system resilience, and strategic innovation, and represent SI Archive engineering with customers and senior leadership from executive briefings to escalations
Foster a culture of technical rigor, collaboration, and high standards by hiring, developing, and growing a high-performing organization of engineering managers and engineers

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

new_jobs.title: Research Director, Agentic AI Platforms
new_jobs.description:
Overview

About the Role & Team

IDC is seeking a Research Director to join our established worldwide artificial intelligence, data and automation (AD&A) research domain to focus on agentic AI tools and platforms. The candidate will have to demonstrate deep existing knowledge of both the existing and future capabilities across all types of agentic AI tools and platforms, including those that can build, manage, orchestrate and govern AI agents for use in the enterprise. The candidate will also collaborate with other analysts covering adjacent technologies including other forms of AI and Automation technologies. Research will include understanding market drivers and trends, buying behaviors, and the business value impact of these technologies. The candidate will employ IDC research methodologies to size markets and forecast market growth.

What You’ll Do

Identify key market trends in agentic AI, as well as broader AI technology and market developments.

Developments. Additional Responsibilities Include

Analyze competitive market strategies and conduct market segment and sizing studies.
Contribute to ongoing research to analyze trends in these segments, including the competitive strategy and financial performance of technology providers, and end user demand for those offers.
Provide industry expertise for client-facing engagements and client inquiries.
Partner with sales and drive incremental revenue through subscription and custom solutions for our AD&A group.
Utilize knowledge of key digital transformation drivers as well as key enterprise IT challenges in software development, business automation, integration, and AI (predictive, interpretive, and generative).
Respond to client requests for market/competitive data across these agentic AI tool and platform technology markets.
Collaborate with other analysts, particularly in other AI research areas, in creating research documents and forecasts.
Present to senior management including C-Level executives across the domain as well as interviewing/interacting with a wide range of IT and technology vendor decision-makers and senior level audience.

What You Bring

Bachelor’s degree is required; Master’s degree preferred.
Experience working in a technical and/or business transformation capacity implementing AI projects.
First-hand experience using AI tools is a strong plus.
Strong knowledge of the overall AI technology sector is required, along with the ability to analyze trends and provide actionable guidance to technology providers and buyers. Direct experience in this area is ideal.
Up-to-date knowledge of innovations in AI foundation models, agent technologies and the AI industry more broadly.
Knowledge of AI deployment models and the advantages and disadvantages of each.
Demonstrated ability to analyze survey data and provide clear, concise summaries and recommendations.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to analyze, present, and articulate complex data sets.
Strong interpersonal and organizational skills, with the capacity to work both independently and within a team.
Proven ability to read and evaluate financial reports to analyze key drivers that impact companies’ ability to differentiate and remain competitive.
Ability to travel 25-30% for client meetings, industry events, and customer projects.
This role offers the flexibility to work remotely from an approved U.S. location, or onsite at our corporate office in Boston, MA.

Why This Role Stands Out

At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions.

Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long-term career development with a globally respected brand.

What We Offer

15 vacation days per year (increases with tenure; carryover allowed)
10 paid sick days per year
1 week paid new parenting leave
Flexible work options (remote, part-time, flexible hours)
Health, dental, vision, and paramedical coverage for you and your family
Annual healthcare spending account
Employee Assistance Program for counseling and support
Best Doctors medical second opinions
Life, AD&D, and long-term disability insurance
Retirement savings plan with company match (up to 4% of salary)
$75/month technology allowance for home office or phone expenses
Company-paid cell phone plan

Compensation Transparency

At IDC, we are committed to fair and equitable pay practices. Employees are compensated equitably for their work, aligned with their skills and experience. Salary and incentive structures are determined through a rigorous process that considers experience, education, certifications, role-specific requirements, internal equity, and verified Canada market data from an independent third-party partner. The expected total annual compensation, depending on location and experience, is between 110,200 CAD – 137,700 CAD, inclusive of base salary and variable compensation. If this role relocates to a different country, the salary range will be updated to reflect that country's range, rather than a currency conversion of the original range.

Equal Opportunity Employer

IDC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons. Employment eligibility verification required. We participate in E-Verify.
